items.name: Outfit, Peasant's
items.description:
Source PZO1110

This set of clothes consists of a loose shirt and baggy breeches, or a loose shirt and skirt or overdress. Cloth wrappings are used for shoes.

items.name: Outfit, Traveler's
items.description:
Source PZO1110

This set of clothes consists of boots, a wool skirt or breeches, a sturdy belt, a shirt (perhaps with a vest or jacket), and an ample cloak with a hood.

items.name: Pot, Cooking (Iron)
items.description:
Source PZO1110
 
Cooking pots come in a variety of materials, but the most common is formed of iron.
 
A mithral cooking pot weighs 2 lbs. and costs 2,001 gp.
 
Empty Weight: 2 lb.; Capacity: 1 gallon/8 lb.

items.name: Fishing Net
items.description:
Source Ultimate Equipment pg. 56, PRPG Core Rulebook pg. 158
Price 4 gp; Weight 5 lbs.
Category Adventuring Gear
DescriptionThis net measures 5 feet by 5 feet, and can be used to cover a pit or to block Tiny or larger creatures from entering an area.

items.name: Waterskin
items.description:
Source PZO1110
 
A water or wineskin holds 1/2 gallon of liquid and weighs 4 lb when full.
 
Empty Weight: -; Capacity: 1/2 gallon/4 lb.1
 
1 When made for Medium characters. Weighs one-quarter the normal amount when made for Small characters. Weighs twice the normal amount when made for Large characters. Containers carry one-quarter the normal amount when made for Small characters.

items.name: Rations, Fish
items.description:
Rations, Trail
Price 5 sp; Weight 1 lb.

The listed price is for a day's worth of food. This bland food is usually some kind of hard tack, jerky, and dried fruit, though the contents vary from region to region and the race of those creating it. As long as it stays dry, it can go for months without spoiling.
